verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a public REST API for products, sales, subscribers, and licenses, plus app integrations. It has no evidence of registrable webhooks, signed deliveries, automatic retries, event logs, or replay. A REST API and third-party app connections are adjacent capabilities, not webhook delivery, so this applicable axis is unmet.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on signed webhook deliveries with automatic retries, event logs, and replay to keep my system consistent with payment state
